audience_basis: Assumed first-time contributor making the requested bounded local documentation edit; no participant research supplied.

journeys.goal: Complete a bounded local documentation edit without unrelated setup
steps: Compare requirements to local task scope
journeys.expected: Only task-relevant local setup is required
journeys.observed: All 91 fields and production deployment credentials are mandatory in the source instructions

journeys.goal: Follow a supported configuration-validation example when profiles are needed
journeys.observed: --organization is absent; supplied interface advertises --org, --project and --ready
journeys.evidence_method: static interface comparison; no command executed

journeys.goal: Understand validation and retirement status correctly
steps: Read claimed runtime-security and retirement conclusions
Compare claims with supplied pilot inventory and known validation limits
journeys.expected: Configuration, runtime assurance, deployment deletion and retirement closure are distinguished
journeys.observed: Instructions equate profile validation with runtime security and deployment deletion with closure despite unresolved residual assets

findings.consequence: The first bounded task appears to require organization-wide adoption
findings.correction: Let contributors begin with task-relevant local instructions; collect additional policy decisions when relevant

findings.consequence: Contributors are directed to obtain sensitive access that the task does not need
findings.correction: Remove this prerequisite from local documentation work

findings.consequence: The supplied interface does not support the documented flag
findings.correction: Use --org and actual profile paths; include --project for a project profile when present; do not claim command execution

findings.consequence: Users may mistake a configuration result for tested runtime controls
findings.correction: State the validator's scope and require separate evidence for runtime assurance

findings.consequence: Residual automation, access and data obligations may be missed
findings.correction: Report deployment deletion separately from pending retirement closure

draft_recheck.method: Static reread: removes all-fields/production prerequisites, uses advertised option names, names actual missing runtime checks and unresolved retirement assets
draft_recheck.producer_disclosure: Reviewer authored the proposed revision; this is not independent final verification
